name: Download an image programmatically
goal: To set an image as desktop background, I must download it first.

approach.text:
I started out by searching for the NASA API. Using this source, I found the endpoint I have to use to retrieve the image: <<source NASA. (n.d.). NASA open APIs. NASA APIs. Retrieved August 13, 2025, from https://api.nasa.gov/>>
To download the image, I used the following source: <<source Kulyk, O. (2024, July 25). How to download images with C#? ScrapingAnt. Retrieved August 13, 2025, from https://scrapingant.com/blog/download-image-c-sharp>>
I combined the knowledge from the sources and my previous knowledge about file saving to save the image to a folder on my PC.

normalLearnings: I can download an image from a url.
result: The following code saves the picture of the day made by NASA to a folder on the PC.<<image 1.png>>
validation: I tested the code on numerous days, all giving a successful result.
contribution: This feature is a core part of the application.
